headline: FED HOLDS AT 3.50-3.75% WEDNESDAY — Silver Drops After Decision; Gold Defends $4,000 Floor Ahead of PCE Data Thursday
snippet: The Federal Reserve held its benchmark rate at 3.50%–3.75% at the July 29 FOMC meeting as expected, but silver declined in the aftermath as Chair Warsh's statement maintained hawkish optionality — keeping the door open to a September hike if June PCE data disappoints. Gold defended the $4,000 floor. The real binary moment now shifts to Thursday morning, when June PCE releases at 8:30 a.m. ET: a soft print could unlock the relief rally in precious metals that FOMC uncertainty has suppressed since early July, while a hot number would validate the hawks and put $3,800 back in play.

headline: AURO METALS DRILLS 542m @ 0.60 g/t Au, 0.12% Cu IN ECUADOR — Third Batch Grades 15% ABOVE INFERRED MODEL; Santa Barbara South Porphyry Continuity Confirmed (TSXV: AURO)
snippet: Auro Metals (TSXV: AURO) reported July 28 the third batch of Phase I 2026 results from the Santa Barbara Gold-Copper Project in southeastern Ecuador, with drillhole DSB-60 returning 542 metres of continuous gold-copper mineralisation at grades approximately 15% above the existing 205.7-million-tonne inferred resource model — confirming deep porphyry continuity through the Santa Barbara South zone. Earlier holes in the same batch returned 625 metres and 705 metres of mineralisation at comparable grades. With resource geometry tightening and intercepts consistently beating the current model, Santa Barbara is tracking toward a resource update later in 2026 that could materially expand the envelope of one of the more significant gold-copper porphyries advancing on the TSXV.

headline: FOX TUNGSTEN HITS SCHEELITE IN 10 OF 10 HOLES — Three NEW Parallel Fox North Zones Found 375-675m West of BK Zone; Assays Pending (TSXV: FOXT)
snippet: Fox Tungsten Ltd. (TSXV: FOXT) reported July 28 that its fully funded 20,000-metre diamond drill program at the Fox Project in British Columbia has intersected visible scheelite mineralisation in all 10 holes drilled to date — including three previously unrecognised parallel zones at Fox North located 375 to 675 metres west of the main BK Zone. All seven RC resource expansion holes have also returned scheelite, extending the known footprint southward toward the BN Zone. Assays are pending; with two rigs turning, Fox Tungsten — drilling for one of the few NATO-listed critical minerals with production concentrated in China and Russia — is systematically proving that the Fox system is wider and more continuous than the existing resource footprint.

headline: GEMDALE GOLD PONTIO FINLAND: DIORITE HOST WIDENS TO 100m+ TRUE WIDTH — N2 Sector Infill Confirms Bulk-Tonnage Open-Pit Scale; Resource Estimate Eyed for Early 2027 (TSXV: GEMG)
snippet: Gemdale Gold Inc. (TSXV: GEMG) released July 28 the first 14 results from its 28-hole, 5,009-metre 2026 infill program at the Pontio Gold Project in western-central Finland, with the N2 Sector of the M2 Trend now demonstrating a mineralised diorite host exceeding 100 metres estimated true width on multiple profiles — significantly broader than previously mapped. The near-surface, bulk-tonnage style gold system continues to grow; a maiden resource estimate is planned for early 2027, with a second phase of drilling commencing in August 2026. Pontio sits within the same Fennoscandian Shield geological setting as several advanced Finnish gold projects gaining EU Critical Raw Materials Act momentum.

headline: GRIT METALS CONFIRMS FERTILE LCT PEGMATITE SYSTEM IN KAUSTINEN DISTRICT — Spodumene Boulders Return 2.35% Li₂O; Maiden 2,787m Drill Finds Highly Fractionated Bodies (TSXV: FIN)
snippet: Grit Metals Corp. (TSXV: FIN) announced July 28 that its 2,787-metre maiden diamond drill program across the Kyrölä and Mörkylä targets at the Central Finland Lithium Project has confirmed a fertile Lithium-Cesium-Tantalum (LCT) pegmatite system, with drill intersections showing geochemical enrichment in lithium, cesium, tantalum, and beryllium — all key fractionation indicators of economic LCT-type deposits. New surface spodumene-bearing boulders at the Jylhä target returned assays of 2.0% and 2.35% Li₂O, the highest values yet from the project and comparable to grades at Keliber's adjacent lithium deposit 1.5 km along strike. The Kaustinen district is emerging as Europe's most competitive lithium pegmatite address in a geopolitically stable jurisdiction.

headline: ELEMENT 29 WINS 5-YEAR PERUVIAN DRILL PERMIT AT ELIDA Cu-Mo-Ag PORPHYRY — Government Upgrade Clears Regulatory Hurdle for 2026 Expanded Program in Apurímac (TSXV: ECU)
snippet: Element 29 Resources (TSXV: ECU) announced July 28 receipt of an upgraded five-year drill permit from Peruvian authorities for the Elida Porphyry Copper-Molybdenum-Silver project in Apurímac — one of Peru's most active copper exploration corridors. The authorisation supports an expanded 2026 program beyond the previous permit scope and removes the permitting risk that has been the primary overhang on the stock. Elida sits in a region that hosts several large copper porphyry deposits and is advancing toward a resource estimate at a time when Citi is maintaining a US$15,000/t copper price target by year-end.

headline: BAYHORSE SILVER: OREGON WILDFIRE BURNED TO MINE PERIMETER, FACILITY INTACT — Access Road Reinstated, Underground Drill Program Resumes (TSXV: BHS)
snippet: Bayhorse Silver Inc. (TSXV: BHS) confirmed July 28 that the Fox Creek wildfire — which grew to more than 45,000 acres and forced suspension of underground drilling on July 24 — has been contained and extinguished, with CEO Graeme O'Neill personally inspecting the access road and mine facilities. While fire burned close to the Ore-Sorter shelter, the building's non-flammable construction protected its contents, and no other facilities were damaged. Drilling is resuming at a mine that sits beside the Snake River's Brownlee Reservoir in eastern Oregon, with silver prices holding above $57 despite FOMC headwinds.

headline: GOLDSILVER.COM: THE VOTE COUNT MATTERS MORE THAN THE HOLD — A 9-5 Dissent vs 12-2 Is a Completely Different Q3 Signal for Gold and Silver
snippet: A GoldSilver.com analysis published ahead of the July 29 FOMC meeting argues that the number of dissenting votes is a more useful signal than the hold/hike binary itself — specifically, whether the July decision produces a near-unanimous hold with soft language (bullish for precious metals) or a split decision with a large dissenting bloc pushing for a hike (which keeps September rate risk elevated). The June FOMC minutes revealed a 9-to-8 committee split; how far that cohesion has moved in either direction will define whether gold recovers toward $4,200 or re-tests $3,800. The press conference language on inflation trajectory is identified as the second critical variable, above even the vote count itself.

headline: ALLEGIANCE GOLD: GOLD HAS RALLIED 10%+ AFTER EVERY PRIOR HOLD-WITH-OPEN-LANGUAGE FED DECISION — History Points to Q3 Window Opening NOW
snippet: An Allegiance Gold analysis for July 29 identifies a consistent historical pattern: gold has rallied an average of more than 10% in the 60 days following every FOMC meeting where the Fed held rates while explicitly leaving the door open to future action — the "hold and monitor" posture that Chair Warsh is widely expected to deliver Wednesday. With gold already down roughly 28% from its January $5,595 peak and major banks (Goldman, JPMorgan) maintaining year-end targets above $4,500, the combination of historically compressed valuations, intact structural demand drivers, and a typical post-hold seasonal tailwind makes this one of the higher-probability gold entry setups of the current cycle for investors who can tolerate near-term volatility.
